verdict.rationale: Meilisearch's integrations pages list sync connectors: Meilisync for MySQL, PostgreSQL and MongoDB, Firebase collection sync, ActiveRecord auto-sync for Rails, and a first-party Laravel Scout driver. These let a founder ingest content without building a custom pipeline. Evidence is limited to one-line marketing descriptions, and one production user reported the Rails gem falling out of step with the server. Missing for 10: any official web crawler, in-depth connector docs (setup, change capture, sync guarantees), and independent corroboration of the connectors working in practice.

support.subject: As a founder, I can ingest content with an official crawler or connectors instead of writing my own indexing pipeline

citations.quote: Database sync. Sync MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB.
Sync Firebase collections with Meilisearch for powerful search.
